expectedRealization.rationale: Automotive semiconductor scarcity can support supplier pricing/utilization, but company-specific scarcity-to-profit attribution must be verified.

changeHypothesis.summary: The automotive semiconductor shortage was severe enough to cut global and Chinese vehicle output. 士兰微/斯达半导 had strong H1 IGBT/power semiconductor growth and some automotive exposure, but the frozen evidence could not isolate how much earnings acceleration was caused by the automotive shortage rather than broader industrial/white-goods/photovoltaic demand, while both leading price candidates were already in late_reversal.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Auto qualification and constrained capacity can persist for quarters.
disconfirmingEvidence: 士兰微/斯达 strong earnings have multiple end-market drivers, not a clean shortage attribution.
Both leading candidates were late_reversal by Sep10.
韦尔 was de_rated but is not a clean auto-shortage expression.

causalChain.mechanism: Insufficient chips force production cuts despite vehicle demand.
causalChain.failureMode: capacity catches up or OEM demand weakens

causalChain.mechanism: Only qualified automotive chip suppliers with material exposure can monetize high utilization/pricing.
causalChain.failureMode: earnings are driven by unrelated end-markets or auto exposure is immaterial

directWinners: qualified auto power-semiconductor suppliers with material automotive revenue
secondOrderWinners: foundry/test capacity used by auto chips
falseThemeMatches: broad semiconductor stocks with no material auto scarcity exposure

aShareCandidates.name: 士兰微
aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: EV motor-drive IGBT modules began batch supply and IGBT revenue grew >110%, but total earnings also reflected many non-auto markets.

earningsSensitivity.adverse: shortage attribution proves small and late-reversal price unwinds.

aShareCandidates.name: 斯达半导
aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: IGBT supplier with strong H1 growth and automotive relevance, but event-specific earnings attribution remains incomplete.

earningsSensitivity.favorable: NEV IGBT demand drives sustained revisions.
earningsSensitivity.adverse: growth already priced or broader demand slows.

selectionComparison.rationale: No stock is selected because event-specific automotive scarcity exposure and incremental earnings path are not auditable enough at cutoff.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The chip shortage was widely visible; the strongest power-semiconductor names had already rerated over 60d and turned weak over 20d.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Qualified auto suppliers could earn scarcity rents.
expectations.measurableGap: No reliable stock-specific incremental earnings path beyond already-strong H1 results is frozen.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: No selection: physical bottleneck is real, but stock mapping is ambiguous and leading candidates show late-reversal absorption.

bearCase: The shortage remains severe but listed suppliers' strong earnings were already driven/discounted by broader semiconductor demand, while auto OEM production cuts limit unit growth.

invalidationConditions.threshold: fails to become a material driver

nextResearchActions: Require auditable automotive revenue/earnings bridge before any selection.
